item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate\\ncases=[\\n({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'2'}},'current':{'a':{'hash':'9','kind':'file'},'b':{'hash':'2','kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),\\n({'declared':['x','y'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'},'y':{'kind':'file','hash':'z'}}},{'ignored':['y']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n({'declared':['gone','new'],'saved':{'gone':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'}},'current':{'new':{'kind':'file','hash':'b'}}},{},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['gone','new']}),\\n({'declared':['meta'],'saved':{'meta':{'kind':'file','hash':'a','name':'old','timestamp':1}},'current':{'meta':{'kind':'file','hash':'a','name':'new','timestamp':2}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['meta']}),\\n({'declared':[],'saved':{'irrelevant':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'}},'current':{}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})]\\nfor request,policy,expected in cases:\\n rb=copy.deepcopy(request); pb=copy.deepcopy(policy); result=evaluate(request,policy); assert result==expected,(result,expected); assert request==rb; assert policy==pb; assert set(result)=={'needs_review','changed'}\\nrequests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); expected=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]; assert report==expected,(report,expected); assert all(set(x)=={'needs_review','changed'} for x in report); print('all checks passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-m\",\"py_compile\",\"work.py\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"status\",\"--short\"]}},{\"action\":\"read\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\"}}]}"}
